_comment: US support resources. Originally entered from the charter text on 2026-11-07 and
NOT verified against any organisation's own site until 2026-11-12.
RE-VERIFICATION, 2026-11-12. Four entries checked. Two confirmed against the
organisation's own page, two could not be reached at all:
thehotline.org      CONFIRMED  phone, text wording and 24/7 all match.
988lifeline.org     CONFIRMED with two wording corrections (below).
rainn.org           HTTP 403 on every URL tried. The site refuses automated
requests. NOT re-verified.
fcc.gov / 911.gov   HTTP 403 on both. 911 NOT re-verified from an official source.
WHAT WE DID ABOUT THE TWO WE COULD NOT REACH. They are kept, with their ORIGINAL
2026-11-07 date left untouched. That is the point of showing the date in the
interface: a user sees 'Checked 7 Nov' beside those and 'Checked 12 Nov' beside the
others, and can weigh them accordingly. Back-dating them to today would be a lie,
and removing them would leave US users with no sexual-assault resource and no
emergency entry, which is worse than an older date.
To be clear about what is and is not being claimed: a 403 means we could not CHECK
them, not that we have reason to doubt them. Both are among the most widely known
numbers in the country. The gap is provenance, not accuracy. Open them in a normal
browser and update `verified_at` -- that is a two-minute job for a human and
impossible for an automated fetch.
`source_url` and `verification_note` are recorded here but are not columns in the
resources table; this file is the provenance record, the database is the serving
layer.

resources.name: Emergency services (911)
resources.note: For immediate danger. Call if you are in danger right now.
resources.verification_note: NOT re-verified 2026-11-12: both fcc.gov and 911.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated requests. Provenance gap, not an accuracy doubt. Confirm in a browser and update the date.

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.note: Free and confidential. You do not have to call what you are experiencing abuse to talk to them. The service notes that high demand can mean longer waits to reach a live advocate.
resources.verification_note: Confirmed on the organisation's own page: phone, 'Text START to 88788', and 'Free. Confidential. 24/7.' all match. The site prints the number as 1.800.799.SAFE (7233).

resources.name: Deaf Hotline (video phone)
resources.note: A video phone service for Deaf and hard-of-hearing callers, listed by the National Domestic Violence Hotline.
resources.verification_note: Added 2026-11-12 after re-verification surfaced it on thehotline.org. Without it the US set had no accessible route for Deaf callers.

resources.name: RAINN National Sexual Assault Hotline
resources.note: Confidential support for sexual assault, coercion, and unwanted contact.
resources.verification_note: NOT re-verified 2026-11-12: rainn.org, /get-help and hotline.rainn.org all returned HTTP 403 to automated requests. Provenance gap, not an accuracy doubt. Confirm in a browser and update the date.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.note: For emotional crisis or suicidal distress — offered only when that is what someone is describing, never as a reaction to any difficult feeling. Free and confidential. Call, text or chat. Text and chat are also available in Spanish.
resources.verification_note: Confirmed on 988lifeline.org, with two corrections: hours are stated as '24/7/365', not '24/7'; and the page does not print the wording 'Text 988' anywhere — it exposes an sms:988 link only, so the previous text_line wording was ours, not theirs. Chat URL added.
